title: Quinn Quokka's Opposite Parcel Quest | Opposites Song for Kids
creative_reason: Uses the strongest channel learning signal—clear opposites—but replaces the prior playground/parade structure with one connected parcel-delivery story, a quokka hero, an owl guide, portal travel and consequence-driven contrast choices.
not_a_clone: No sequence of unrelated animals demonstrating one word each.
No reused narration, lyrics, title, thumbnail hook or interaction pattern.
Every opposite pair helps Quinn deliver the same parcel through a connected story.

music.pacing: Three short phrases per scene, target 105-135 weighted WPM, hard maximum 145 WPM per line, no positive TTS boost and at least 0.4 seconds between phrases.

character_lock.quinn: Quinn, one cheerful golden-brown quokka with round ears, bright brown eyes, soft plush 3D fur, a teal parcel satchel and coral neckerchief
character_lock.olive: Olive, one warm cream-and-caramel owl guide with amber eyes, a plum post cap and tiny brass route badge

visual_direction.quality: Premium cinematic 3D-look portal worlds with rich environmental depth, clean character silhouettes, expressive faces, volumetric light and tactile parcel props.
visual_direction.frame: 1920x1080, 12-column grid, 96px title-safe margin, one focal point on a thirds power point per shot.
visual_direction.layers: Background ambient portal drift 0.2x; midground route and props 0.6x; foreground Quinn or the active parcel 1.2x.
visual_direction.camera: One move per story beat: either a slow push, a short follow or a match cut. Never push, pan and rotate simultaneously.
visual_direction.motion_personality: playful kinetic-soft with 0.6-second base phrase unit, gentle squash on parcel landings and a full-beat hold after each contrast resolves.

scenes.story_action: Quinn receives one empty teal satchel. Olive places three glowing parcels inside until it is visibly full, then points to the first portal route.
lyrics: Quinn's satchel starts out empty.
One, two, three parcels fill it.
A full bag means the quest can start.
scenes.focal: Quinn's surprised face and the empty-to-full satchel at the right-thirds point
scenes.camera: slow push toward the satchel; hold one beat on full

scenes.story_action: A parcel lift rises up to the high orange portal, then returns down so Quinn can collect the route stamp.
lyrics: The parcel lift travels up.
Now it glides safely down.
Quinn catches the stamp below.
scenes.focal: one lift and parcel moving vertically beside Quinn
scenes.camera: vertical follow broken at the midpoint; no full-frame slide

scenes.story_action: Olive shows one near shell mailbox and one far shell mailbox. Quinn chooses the near mailbox for the first parcel, then points toward the far destination for later.
lyrics: This shell mailbox waits nearby.
That blue mailbox glows far away.
Near comes first on Quinn's route.
scenes.focal: near shell mailbox large foreground; far mailbox small in depth
scenes.camera: rack-like scale change from far to near without a zoom-spin

scenes.story_action: A tiny cart begins too fast near the bridge. Quinn slows it to a careful pace so the parcel remains level and arrives safely.
lyrics: The little cart rolls too fast.
Quinn makes the wheels turn slow.
Slow and steady keeps parcels safe.
scenes.focal: Quinn's paw on the brake and one stable parcel
scenes.camera: brief follow, then long settled hold after the slowdown

scenes.story_action: The blue delivery gate is closed. Quinn matches the brass route badge; the gate opens and reveals the waiting recipient platform.
lyrics: The blue delivery gate is closed.
Quinn matches Olive's route badge.
The correct gate opens wide.
scenes.focal: closed-to-open gate with Quinn anchored at left thirds
scenes.camera: symmetrical locked frame; gate opening is the only bold motion

scenes.story_action: Quinn compares one light feather parcel and one heavy seed parcel, then places each on the correct side of a friendly balance cart.
lyrics: A feather parcel feels so light.
The seed parcel feels heavy.
Quinn balances both with care.
scenes.focal: one readable balance with exactly two different parcels
scenes.camera: side-on balance tilt followed by centered settle

scenes.story_action: The delivered parcels unfold into flags showing each learned pair. Quinn and Olive lead an original opposite-route song while children point left and right with the contrasts.
lyrics: Empty, full; up and down.
Near and far; fast then slow.
Opposites helped Quinn find the way.
scenes.focal: Quinn and Olive foreground with five large readable contrast emblems
scenes.camera: slow celebratory push ending in a stable thumbnail-ready pose

quality_gates: Quinn and Olive remain recognizable and consistently dressed in all seven scenes.
Every scene has one dominant contrast and one connected parcel-story consequence.
Each narrated object and action is visible for the complete phrase.
No story scene exceeds 12 seconds and all transitions are gap-free.
The finale/end card appears only in its intended final event.
Narration passes the 145 WPM per-line and 0.4-second breathing-gap limits.
Full decode, general contact sheet, every-boundary contact sheet and truthful custom thumbnail must be reviewed before release.

preview_review.reason: The connected parcel story is sufficiently different from Animal Opposites Playground, but the first local composite pass uses flat-looking parcel controls and repeats Quinn's pose too often beside premium environments. It is not approved for rendering, queueing or upload.
preview_review.required_revision: Use scene-specific Quinn and Olive poses, tactile dimensional parcel props, integrated world lighting and physical cause-and-effect rather than UI-like panels. Preserve one focal action and the connected quest.
